# Class: `_SessionFingerprintWriter`

Hashes serialized session content without retaining another copy of the text.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-session-io.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_session_io.py#L220) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `object`.

Accepts text writes from JSON and CSV serializers, updates a SHA-256 digest with UTF-8 bytes, and returns the number of characters consumed. Used by session_content_fingerprint to detect document changes.
